Danyil

Danyil

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Si Danyil ka migsulat te seini ne baseen. Sabeka sikandin ne matig-Huda ne indakep peendiye te Babilunya te lukes-lukes pad sikandin. Insulat din seini te timpu te mig-antus amana ka me Hudiyu te pegbayad-bayad wey pegdeeg-deeg te Hari ne migsimba te diyus-diyus. Nasulat kayi ka meyitenged te pegkeyimu ni Danyil ne labew te me upisyal diye te Babilunya wey ka pegkamatinumanen din te pegpamakey te Manama te timpu te pegmandu enni Hari Nibukadnisar, Bilsasar, Daryu, wey Sirus. Ne nasulat degma kayi ka meyitenged te tatelu ne me alukuy rin ne ensi Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu.

Danyil was (the one who) wrote this document. He was one from Judah (MS Huda) who was_captured (and) taken to Babilunya while he was still a young_man. He wrote this at a time when the Hudiyus (MS Hudiyu) greatly suffered from persecution and oppression by a king who worshiped false_god(s). It's written here about how Danyil became the highest of the officials there in Babilunya and his righteousness in serving God (MS Manama) in the time of the ruling of Kings Nebuchadnezzar (MS Nibukadnisar), Belshasar (MS Bilsasar), Darius (MS Daryu), and Cyrus (MS Sirus). And it's also written here about his three friends who were Shadrack (MS Sadrak), Meshach (Misak), and Abednego (MS Abidnigu).

Nasulat degma kayi ka immakita te Manama ki Danyil ne migtagne meyitenged te pegkamaresen wey pegkahuhus te duma ne me nasud bunsud te Babilunya. Intagne degma kayi ke nekey ka egkeyitabu te mewuri ne me timpu.

It's also written here the revealing by God to Danyil who predicted about the strength and destruction of other nations starting with Babilunya. It's also predicted here what would/will_happen in later times.

Nasulat pad man-e te seini ne baseen ne iyan egbuut ka Manama te langun ne egkeyitabu kayi te ampew te tane. Sikandin ka eggimu te me nasud wey sikandin ded degma ka egdereet kayi. Sikandin degma ka egtanggu te keet-etawan din wey egpamatarengen din ka kalibutan te mewuri ne me timpu.

It's also written in this document that it's God who controls all that happens here in the world (LIT on top of the earth). He (is the one) who makes nations and he also ruins them. He also looks_after his people and will_make_ the world _righteous in later times.

KA GUHUREN NI DANYIL WEY TE ME ALUKUY RIN (1:1–6:28)

THE STORY BY DANIEL AND HIS FRIENDS (1:1–6:28)

Si Danyil wey ka me alukuy rin diye te Babilunya

Danyil and his friends there in Babilunya

11 [xr]Te igkatelu ne leg-un te peghari ni Huwakim ne Hari te Huda, miggendiye te Hirusalim si Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya duma te me sundalu rin wey inlingutan dan seini. 2 [xr]Ne intuhutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkatalu ni Hari Nibukadnisar si Huwakim wey in-ahew rin ka me kasangkapan diye te timplu te Manama. Ne in-uyan din e seini te miglibed diye te ugpaan din diye te Babilunya,[fn] wey diye din itahu te sinabeng ne tinesanan te karatuan din diye te baley te manama rin.

11 [xr]In the third year of the kinging by Huwakim the king of Huda, King Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya went to Hirusalim along_with his soldiers and they surrounded it. 2 [xr]And the Lord God allowed Huwakim to be defeated by King Nebuchadnezzar and he took/snatched the utensils/furniture from the Temple of God. And he took these when returning to his residence in Babilunya,[fn] and there he put them in the room that was the_storing_place of his riches in the house of his god(s).

3 Nataman, insuhu ni Nibukadnisar si Aspinas, ka pangulu te me upisyal rin ne egpaalamen te me kanakan puun te naddakep ne me matig-Israil ne egpuun te kabuhalan te me Hari wey ka duma puun te talahuren ne pamilya. 4 Keilangan ne meupiya se peglelawa ran, meupiya ne egpitawen, matagseb, mahaan egkateu, wey eleg ne egpamakey diye te palasyu te Hari. Igpepanulu degma sikandan ki Aspinas te pegbasa te mallehen ne egsabuten wey te peglalag te linalahan te matig-Babilunya. 5 Migsuhu man-e ka Hari ne egsendaran sikandan tagse aldew te keenen wey inumen ne iling te kandin ne egkakeen wey egkeinum. Egbasbasen sikandan te tatelu ne leg-un, human igpatrabahu diye te ugpaan te Hari. 6 Ka duma te naalam iyan ensi Danyil, Hananiyas, Misail, wey si Asariyas ne namuun te me kabuhalan ni Huda. 7 Ne impangngaranan sikandan te iyam ne ngaran te pangulu te me upisyal ne si Aspinas. Si Danyil migngaranan din ki Biltisasar, si Hananiyas migngaranan din ki Sadrak, si Misail migngaranan din ki Misak, wey si Asariyas migngaranan din ki Abidnigu.

3 Then, Nebuchadnezzar commanded Aspinas, the leader of his officials to_choose some young_men from (those) captured(pl) from_Israil who were from descendants of kings and other(s) from respected families. 4 It was necessary that their health was good, good to look_at, wise, learn quickly, and suitable to serve in the palace of the king. If you(sg) are seen by him to be skinnier than your(sg) young_men companions, what if I'm killed by him.”

Ka taheinep ni Nibukadnisar

The dream of Nebuchadnezzar

21 Te sabeka ne marusilem te migdaruwe e ne leg-un si Nibukadnisar ka mighari, nakataheinep sikandin te kamasulug. Purisu nangendiyad sikandan te Hari. 3 Ne impangguhuran e sikandan te Hari te migkahi, “Due taheinep ku ne ingkabantali ku wey egkeupian a ne egkanengnengan ka igpasabut kayi.” 4 Ne migtabak ka egmahehane ne iyan inggamit ka Aramayik ne linalahan,[fn] “Mahal ne Hari, egkeuyag ka te ware egtamanan! Nangeni key nikeykew se me suluhuanen nu te taheinep nu wey egluwasen ney seini.”

21 On one night in the second year of Nebuchadnezzar's reigning, he dreamed many_times. Therefore they went(pl) to the king. 3 And they were_told by the king saying, “I had a dream that worried me and I want to know what it means.” 4 And the prophesiers answered using the Aramaic language,[fn] “Honored king, may you(sg) without ending! Ka pegluwas ni Danyil te taheinep te Hari

The interpreting by Danyil of the dream of the king

24 Seeye naa, miglibed e si Danyil diye ki Aryuk, ka insuhu te Hari te pegpangimatey te me matagseb ne me etew diye te Babilunya. Ne migkahiyan e ni Danyil si Aryuk, “Kene nu pangimatayi ka me matagseb ne me etew kayi te Babilunya. Dumaa a nikeykew diye te Hari su egluwasen ku ka igpasabut te taheinep din.”

Kuntee, ignangen ku keykew ke nekey seeye se nakita nu diye te taheinep nu. 29 Ka taheinep nu Mahal ne Hari, iyan sika se egkeyitabu keureme wey impataha sika te Manama ne talagpataha te me malised ne egsabuten. 30 Malehet iya ne kayi te keddi ipanengneng ka taheinep nu, piru kene ne tenged su matmatagseb a du te duma, ke kene, pinaahi te bulig te Manama keddi. Egkeupian sikandin ne egkasabut nu ke nekey ka due te suman-suman[fn] nu.

Now, I will_tell you(sg) what you(sg) saw in your(sg) dream. 29 Your(sg) dream Honored King, it was about (what) will_happen in_the_future and that was_made_known by God the one_who_makes_known difficult things_to_understand. 30 It's indeed true that it was me that your(sg) dream was_made_known, not because I'm wiser than other(s), but rather, by_means of the help of God to_me. He wants you(sg) to understand what is in your(sg) mind.[fn]

31 “Ka nakita nu Mahal ne Hari, sabeka ne bubuyahen ne larawan ne subla ne masil-ew. Diye seini migsasindeg te tangkaan nu wey makaaldek-haldek ne egpitawen. 32 Ne neelin ne bulawan ka ulu rin, wey pelata ka kumeng din wey ka belad din, ne burunsi ka getek din wey ka bubun din. 33 Ne putew ka me lisen din wey nasinewug te putew wey tane ne eggimuwen ne kuren ka me paa rin. 34 Taheed te egpipitew ka te larawan, due batu ne natipak, piru kene ne etew ka migtipak kayi. Nasuhat ka me paa te larawan wey nalupet e seini. 35 Ne nalupet iling te ukaba diye te diekanan ka putew, ka tane ne eggimuwen ne kuren, ka burunsi, ka pelata, wey ka bulawan. Ne miglayap e seeye te kalamag wey warad iya nasame. Piru ka batu ne nakasuhat te paa te larawan, neyimu e ne dakel ne bubungan wey nekeempet e te intiru ne kalibutan.

31 “What_ you(sg) _saw Honored King, (was) one enormous statue that shone exceedingly. This stood there in front of you(sg) and (was) frightening to look_at. 32 Its head (was) all gold, and its chest and arms (were) silver, and the stomach and the thigh(s) were bronze. 33 Its calves (were) iron and its legs/feet (were) a mixture of iron and dirt that's used_for_making clay_pots. 34 While you(sg) looked at the statue, there_was a stone/rock that was_cut/loosened_from_a_hill, but it wasn't a person that loosened it. The feet/legs of the statue were hit and they disintegrated. 35 And like chaff at the trampling_place the iron, the dirt that's made_into clay_pot(s), the bronze, the silver, and the gold disintegrated. And they were_blown_away by the wind and there_wasn't any remainder. But the stone/rock that hit the feet/legs of the statue, became a large mountain and covered the entire earth.

36 “Seeye ka taheinep nu. Na, kuntee egluwasen kud due te keykew ka igpasabut kayi. 37 Mahal ne Hari, sikeykew ka Hari te me hari. Inggimu ka te Manama ne diye te langit ne Hari wey imbehayan te geem, keseg, wey te kabantug. 38 Imbehey rin degma keykew ka langun ne etew, me mahintalunan ne mananap wey me bayaku minsan hendei sikandan nangugpe, wey inggimu ka nikandin ne talagmandu te langun. Sikeykew ka igpasabut te seeye se ulu te larawan. 39 Emun ke egkatalu e ka migharian, ne iyan ka migharian nu kuntee, due lein ne Hari ne egginguma ne malmaletey keykew, ne duen pad man-e igkatelu ne eghari ne iyan igpasabut seeye se burunsi, wey egmandu sikandin te intiru ne kalibutan. 40 Duen pad man-e igkeep-at ne migharian ne egpekeiling karesen te putew. Eglupeten din seeye se langun ne nekewun-a ne mighari, iling te putew ne egpakalupet te minsan nekey. 41 Ka nakita nu ne paa wey ka me kemel te paa ne nasinewug te putew wey tane, palinneu ne egkabaad ka seini ne migharian. Piru ka kalig-en ne egpekeiling te putew, duen ded diye te kandin, iling te nakita nu ne impegsewug ne putew te tane. 42 Ka me kemel te paa ne nekegsewug te putew wey tane, palinneu te due kalig-en wey due degma kahuye te seini ne migharian. 43 Nakita nu degma ne nekegsewug ka putew te tane, migpasabut sika te egkasabeka sikandan pinaahi te pegpaas-asaweey. Piru kene sikandan egkaluhey iling te ka putew kene iya egpakasewug te tane. 44 Te timpu te seeye ne me Hari, ka Manama te langit egpasasindeg te migharian ne kenad iya egkareetan wey warad iya minsan hentew ne egpakaahew te seini ne migharian. Egdereetan kayi ka langun ne migharian wey egpalunggehaat seini te ware katamanan. 45 Sika ka igpasabut te nakita nu ne batu ne natipak puun te dalama ne kene ne etew ka nakatipak, wey nakalupet te putew, te burunsi, te tane, te pelata, wey te bulawan. Mahal ne Hari, migpanengneng keykew ka mabantug ne Manama ke nekey ka egkeyitabu keureme. Malehet ka taheinep nu wey ka igpasabut kayi.”

36 “That was your(sg) dream. Now_then, now I'll interpret to you(sg) what_is_meant by it. 37 Honored King, you(sg) (are) the king of kings. You(sg) were_made king by the God there in heaven/sky and given power, strength, and honor. 38 He also gave you(sg) all the people, the wild animals and birds wherever they live, and you(sg) were_made by him the ruler of all. You(sg) (are) the interpretation of that head of the statue. 39 When the kingdom, that you(sg) are now kinging will_be_defeated, there will_be_another king who will_arrive somewhat_weaker than you(sg), and there will_ also _be a third (who) will_reign understood as that bronze, and he will_rule the entire world. 40 There's still also a fourth kingdom like the strength of iron. He will_shatter all those who precede (him) in reigning, like iron can shatter anything. 41 The feet/legs that you(sg) saw and the toes that were_mixed iron and dirt, (are) a sign that this kingdom will_become_divided. But the strength that's like iron, will_remain there with him, like you(sg) saw that was iron and dirt mixed. 42 The toes mixed of iron and dirt, (are) a sign that there_is strength and there_is also weakness in this kingdom. 43 You(sg) also saw the iron and the dirt mixed_together, that means they will_unite by marrying_together. But they won't last_long like iron indeed can't mix with dirt. 44 At the time of those kings, the God of heaven/sky will_stand_up a kingdom that won't indeed be_destroyed and no one at all will_be_able_to_snatch this kingdom. It will_destroy all kingings and this (kingdom) will_remain without ending. 45 That's what_is_meant by the stone/rock that you(sg) saw cut/loosened from a cliff and it wasn't a person that cut/loosened it, and (it) was_able_to_shatter iron, bronze, dirt, silver, and gold. Honored King, the great God has made_known to you(sg) what will_happen in_the_future. Your(sg) dream was correct and what_is_meant by it.”

Ka pegdasag ki Danyil te Hari

The giving_gifts to Danyil by the king

46 Ne miglangkeb si Hari Nibukadnisar eyew te pegtahud ki Danyil wey migsuhu sikandin ne eghalad wey egtutung te insinsu diye te tangkaan ni Danyil. 47 Migkahiyan te Hari si Danyil, “Malehet iya ne ka Manama nu, Manama te me manama wey Magbebaye ne Manama te me Hari wey ka talagpataha te me malised ne egsabuten tenged su nekeyimu ke ma te pegpanengneng te seini se me malised ne egsabuten.” 48 Ne nataman, impamehayan e te Hari si Danyil te mateles wey mahal ne me dasag. Imparakel rin degma ka katungdanan din diye te intiru ne prubinsya te Babilunya wey inggimu sikandin ne pangulu te langun ne matagseb diye te Babilunya. 49 Ne mighangyu si Danyil te Hari ne egbulihen din ensi Sadrak, si Misak, wey si Abidnigu te pegmandu diye te prubinsya te Babilunya. Ne migpalunggehaat de si Danyil te palasyu.

46 And King Nebuchadnezzar lay_face_down in_order to respect Danyil and he commanded sacrifice and burning of incense there in front of Danyil. 47 The king said to Danyil, “It's indeed true that your(sg) God, is the God of gods and the Lord God of kings and the (one) who_makes_known difficult understanding because you(sg) could_do the making_known of this difficult understanding.” 48 And then, Danyil was_given(pl) beautiful and expensive gifts by the king. He also enlarged his responsibilities there in the entire province of Babilunya and he was_made the leader of all the wise there in Babilunya. 49 And Danyil requested of the king that Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu help him in ruling the province of Babilunya. And Danyil just remained in the palace.

Ka suhu ne igpasimba ka larawan

The command that the statue be worshiped

31 Ne migpeyimu si Hari Nibukadnisar te larawan ne bulawan. Daruwa ne pulu wey pitu (27) ne mitrus ka katikang kayi wey tatelu ne mitrus ka kakepal. Diye din seeye ipasasindeg te napu te Dura ne sakup te prubinsya te Babilunya. 2 Ne impeumew ni Hari Nibukadnisar ka me gubirnadur, me mayur, me kagawad, me talagtambag, me talaggen-gen te seleppi, me talewukum, me pangulu, wey ka langun ne me upisyal te me prubinsya eyew egpatambungen te peghalad te larawan ne impeyimu rin. 3 Te nalibulung e sikandan langun se impatambung te peghalad, diyad sikandan nanasindeg te tangkaan te larawan ne bulawan. 4 Ne migpanguleyi e ka tigpanengneng, “Sikaniyu se langun ne keet-etawan te nalein-lein ne tribu wey namuun te minsan hendei ne nasud wey nalein-lein se linalahan, egbanasalan kew 5 ne emun ke egkarineg niyu ka dahing te trumpita, pulendag, kuglung, salurey, wey duma pad ne eggamiten te peg-ulahing, usengul kew diye te tane wey simbaa niyu ka larawan ne bulawan ne impeyimu ni Hari Nibukadnisar. 6 Ne minsan hentew ne kene eg-usengul diye te tane wey kene egsimba, due-rue ne igdegpak diye te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab.” 7 Purisu te pegkarineg te langun ne keet-etawan te nalein-lein ne tribu wey namuun te minsan hendei ne nasud wey linalahan te dahing te trumpita, pulendag, kuglung, salurey, wey duma pad ne eggamiten te peg-ulahing, mig-usengul e sikandan diye te tane wey insimba ran ka larawan ne bulawan ne impeyimu ni Hari Nibukadnisar.

31 And King Nebuchadnezzar had_made a gold statue. The height of it was twenty-seven (27) meters and the width was three meters. He had_ it _stood on the plain of Dura under_the_jurisdiction of the province of Babilunya. 2 And King Nebuchadnezzar had_called the governors, mayors, councillors, advisors, holders of money, judges, leaders, and all the officials of the provinces in_order for attending the dedication of the statue that he had had_made. 3 When they had all gathered to attend the feast, they stood(pl) there in front of the gold statue. 4 And the announcer shouted, “You(pl) all the people of various tribes and from(pl) whatever nations and with different languages, you(pl) are_commanded 5 that if you(pl) hear the sound of the trumpet, flute, zither, bamboo_saluroy, or others that are used for singing, bow_face_down(pl) to the ground and worship(pl) the gold statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has had_made. 6 And whoever doesn't bow_face_down(pl) to the ground and doesn't worship, will immediately be thrown into a big fire that's blazing.” 7 Therefore when all the people of various languages and coming_from(pl) from whatever nations and languages heard the sound of the trumpet, flute, zither, bamboo_saluroy, or others that are used for singing, they bowed_face_down(pl) to the ground and they worshiped the gold statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had had_made.

Ka pegsupak enni Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu

The disobeying by Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu

8 Te seeye ne timpu, due me mammituen ne migparani te Hari wey migsumbung meyitenged te me Hudiyu. 9 Migkahiyan dan si Hari Nibukadnisar, “Mahal ne Hari, egkeuyag ka te ware egtamanan! 10 Migsuhu ka ne ka seeye se egpakarineg te dahing te trumpita, pulendag, kuglung, salurey, wey duma pad ne eggamiten te peg-ulahing, keilangan ne eg-usengul diye te tane wey egsimba te larawan ne impeyimu nu. 11 Ne seeye se kene eg-usengul wey kene egsimba, igdegpak diye te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab. 12 Na, due me Hudiyu ne in-alam nu ne egpangulu diye te intiru ne prubinsya te Babilunya ne ensi Sadrak, Misak wey Abidnigu. Ka seini ne me etew, Mahal ne Hari, ware migparuma-ruma keykew wey ware migpamakey te me manama nu, wey ware migsimba te larawan ne bulawan ne impeyimu nu.”

8 At that time, there were some star_readers that approached the king and accused concerning the Hudiyus. 9 They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, “Honored King, may you(sg) live without ending! 10 You(sg) commanded that those who hear the sound of the trumpet, flute, zither, bamboo_saluroy, or others used for singing, (that they) need to bow_face_down(pl) to the ground and worship the statue that you(sg) have had_made. 11 And those who don't bow_face_down and don't worship, will_be_thrown into the big fire that's blazing. 12 Now_then, there are some Hudiyus that you(sg) chose to lead in the entire province of Babilunya who are Sadrak, Misak and Abidnigu. These people, honored king, don't go_along_with you(sg) and don't serve your(sg) gods, and don't worship the gold statute that you(sg) got_made.”

13 Ne dutu, nangebel-ebel e ka langet ni Hari Nibukadnisar wey migsuhu ne igpeuyan ensi Sadrak, Misak wey Abidnigu diye te kandin. Ne in-uuyan e sikandan diye te tangkaan te Hari. 14 Ne mig-insaan din e sikandan, “Malehet naan iya Sadrak, Misak wey Abidnigu ne ware kew migpamakey te me manama ku wey ware migsimba te larawan ne bulawan ne impeyimu ku? 15 Na kuntee, emun ke eg-usengul kew diye te tane ke egkarineg niyu ka dahing te trumpita, pulendag, kuglung, salurey, wey duma pad ne eggamiten te peg-ulahing, wey egsimbeen niyu ka larawan ne impeyimu ku, ne meupiya iya. Piru ke kene kew, due-rue ne igdegpak kew diye te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab. Pitawen te naan iya ke due manama ne egpakaluwas kaniyu.”[fn]

13 And then, the anger of King Nebuchadnezzar smoked and he commanded that Sadrak, Misak and Abidnigu be_brought. And they were_brought to the front of the king. 14 And he asked them, “Is it really correct Sadrak, Misak and Abidnigu that you(pl) don't serve my gods and don't worship the gold statue that I've had_made? 15 Now_then today/now, if you(pl) bow_face_down to the ground when you(pl) hear the sound of the trumpet, flute, zither, bamboo_saluroy, or others used for singing, and you(pl) worship the statue that I've had_made, that'll be good. But if you(pl) don't, you(pl) will_be_immediately thrown into the large fire that's blazing. We(incl) will_see if there_is indeed a good that can_save you(pl).”[fn]

16 Ne migtabak ka tatelu ne talag-alukuy, “Mahal ne Hari, kenad ne keilangan ne egtabaken ney pad sikeykew meyitenged due. 17 Maresen ka Manama ne impamakey ney, wey egluwasen key nikandin puun keykew[fn] wey te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab. 18 Piru minsan pad ke kene key nikandin egluwasen, igpanengneng ney keykew ne kene key iya egpamakey te me manama nu wey egsimba te larawan ne bulawan ne impeyimu nu.”

16 And the three friends answered, “Honored king, we(excl) don't need to respond to you(sg) about this. 17 The God who we(excl) serve is powerful, and we(excl) will_be_saved by him from you(sg)[fn] and from the big fire that's blazing. 18 But even if we(excl) are_ not _saved by_him, we(excl) will_let_ you(sg) _know that we(excl) indeed won't serve your(sg) gods or worship the gold statue that you(sg) had_made.”

Ka pegdegpak engki Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu diye te hapuy

The throwing of Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu into the fire

19 Te sikan de iya, nangebel-ebel e amana ka langet ni Hari Nibukadnisar wey nahuhus ka ulaula rin te kabelu engki Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu. Sikan naa, migsuhu sikandin ne egkapapituwen ne lupi ka keinit te egkanlabkanlab ne hapuy. 20 Ne insuhu din ka kekesehi te me sundalu rin te igpabaku sikandan wey igparegpak diye te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab. 21 Purisu imbebaku e sikandan ne duen pad me kumbale dan, diyakit, salakey wey indegpak e diye te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab. 22 Tenged te mapahetpet ne suhu te Hari ne egpeiniten amana ka dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab, sikan naa ka migpatey seeye se me etew ne migdegpak kandan diye te hapuy. 23 Ne sikandan se tatelu diye migdeeg te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab ne nenabbaku pad.

19 Just then, the anger of King Nebuchadnezzar smoked and his face contorted (LIT collapsed) with anger at Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu. So then, he commanded that the heat of the blazing fire be seven times (hotter). 20 And he commanded his strongest soldiers to bind them and throw them in the big fire that was blazing. 21 Therefore they were bound and they still had clothes, jacket, headband and were thrown into the big fire that was blazing. 22 Due to the strict command of the king that the big fire that was blazing be greatly heated, that's why those people that threw them into the fire died. 23 And those three fell there still bound(pl) into the big fire that was blazing.

24 Ne dutu, neinu-inu si Hari Nibukadnisar wey due-rue ne migsasindeg ne mig-inse te me upisyal rin, “Tatelu man de iya ne etew ka imbaku ta wey indegpak diye te hapuy, menu ma iya?”

24 And then, King Nebuchadnezzar was amazed and immediately stood and asked his officials, “There were just three people that we(incl) bound and threw into the fire, weren't there?”

Ne migtabak sikandan, “Malehet sika, Mahal ne Hari.”

And they answered, “That's correct, Honored King.”

25 Ne migkahi ka Hari, “Piru hep-at ne etew ka egkakita ku kuntee ne warad nenabbaku ne eggiphipanew diye te elat te hapuy wey ware sikandan namenu. Ne ka ikeep-at kandan hendue te panalihan.”[fn]

25 And the king said, “But I saw four people now that aren't bound and are walking_around in the middle of the fire and nothing has happened to them. And the fourth (one) of them is like an angel.”[fn]

26 Sikan naa ka migparani si Hari Nibukadnisar te gumawan te dakel ne hapuy ne egkanlabkanlab wey migpangumew, “Sadrak, Misak wey Abidnigu ne me suluhuanen te Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama, lihawang kew e rue! Hendini kew e!” Ne miglihawang e sikandan se tatelu puun te hapuy. 27 Miglibulungan sikandan te me gubirnadur, me mayur, me kagawad wey te me upisyal te Hari. Ne nakita ran ne ware sikandan namenu te hapuy. Ware natutung ka bulbul ran, ka insaluub dan, wey ware sikandan migngareg te ebel.

26 So then King Nebuchadnezzar approached the doorway of the big fire that was blazing and called, “Sadrak, Misak and Abidnigu who are servants of the Very Great God, come_out(pl) from there! Come_here(pl)!” And those three came_out from the fire. 27 They the governors, mayors, councillors and officials of the king gathered. And they saw that they weren't affected by the fire. Their hair, what_ they _were_wearing wasn't burned, and they didn't smell of smoke.

28 Puun due, migkahi si Hari Nibukadnisar, “Egdayanen ka Manama enni Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu. Impeendini rin ka panalihan din eyew te pegluwas te me suluhuanen din ne migsalig kandin. Ware sikandan migparuma-ruma te suhu ku wey in-awes dan pad ne igtuug te hapuy du te egpamakey wey egsimba te lein ne manama angin e te Manama ran.

28 From that, King Nebuchadnezzar said, “(May) the God of Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu be_praised. He sent_here his angel in_order for saving his servants who trust (in) him. They didn't go_along_with my command and preferred to be roasted in fire than to serve and to worship other gods other than their God.

29 “Purisu egpanengnengen ku ka langun ne keet-etawan te nalein-lein ne tribu wey namuun te minsan hendei ne nasud, ne ka egbaley-baley te Manama enni Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu, egtadtaren wey egguhusen ka me baley ran. Su ware lein ne Manama ne egpakaluwas te iling kayi.”

29 “Therefore I want_to_make_known to all of various languages and coming_from(pl) whatever nation(s), that the (one/s) who blaspheme the God of Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu, will_be_cut_into_pieces and their houses will_be_demolished. Because no other God can_save like this.”

30 Ne intimulan pad te Hari ka katungdanan enni Sadrak, Misak, wey Abidnigu diye te prubinsya te Babilunya.

30 And the king increased more the responsibilities of Sadrak, Misak, and Abidnigu there in the province of Babilunya.

Ka ikarangeb ne taheinep ni Hari Nibukadnisar

The second dream of King Nebuchadnezzar

41 Ne due sulat ne impeuyan ni Hari Nibukadnisar diye te langun ne keet-etawan te nalein-lein ne tribu wey namuun te minsan hendei ne nasud wey linalahan te intiru ne kalibutan:

41 And there_was a letter that King Nebuchadnezzar sent to all the people of various tribes and coming_from(pl) whatever nation(s) and languages of the whole world:

“Egkanasnasian pad perem ka keupianan due te kaniyu!2 Igkahale ku ka pegpangguhud kaniyu te me palinneu wey me kein-inuwan ne inggimu keddi te Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama.

“May peace/prosperity multiply to you(pl)!2 I'm happy to tell you(pl) about signs and wonders that were done to_me by the Very Great God.

3 Amana ka me palinneu

3 The signs are great

wey me kein-inuwan ne inggimu rin!

and the wonders that_ he _has_done!

Ware egtamanan te migharian din wey te pegmandu din.

There's_no end to his kingdom and to his ruling.

4 “Sikeddi si Nibukadnisar, meupiya ka peg-ugpe ku wey matubung ded kayi te palasyu ku. 5 Piru due sabeka ne marusilem ne nakataheinep a te makaaldek-haldek, wey nakakita a te ingkaliyasi ku diye te taheinep ku. 6 Sikan naa ka impanengneng ku ne egpeendiniyen te keddi ka langun ne matagseb ne me etew te Babilunya eyew igpakanangen dan keddi ka igpasabut te taheinep ku. 7 Te pegginguma te egmamulingan, te me timbusawen, te egmahehane, wey te mammituen, innangenan kud e sikandan te taheinep ku piru kene dan egkaluwas ka igpasabut dutu.

4 “I am Nebuchadnezzar, my living is good and there's abundance here in my palace. 5 But there_was one night that I dreamed (something) terrible, and I saw something that scared me in my dream. 6 That's why I made_known that all of the wise people in Babilunya are_to_come_here to me so_that they can tell me what_is_meant by my dream. 7 On the arrival of the magicians, those_with_spirits, the prophesiers, and the star_readers, I told them of my dream but they couldn't tell what_ this _means.

8 “Te katammanan, miggendini te keddi si Danyil ne egngaranan ded ki Biltisasar ne insangey te manama ku. Diye te kandin ka panisingan te matulus ne me manama. Ne innangenan kud e sikandin te taheinep ku. 9 Miggenenduen a, ‘Biltisasar, pangulu te me talagbuwas ne egpakaluwas te taheinep, nakanengneng a ne due te keykew ka panisingan te matulus ne me manama, ne ware inneles ne igkeyirapi nu te pegnengneng, purisu pasabuta a te taheinep ku.

8 “Finally, Danyil who is also named Belteshazzar after my god came to me. The spirit of the holy gods is in him. And I informed him my dream. 9 I went_like_this, ‘Belteshazzar, leader of healers_who_can_interpret_dreams, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is with you(sg), and nothing is hidden that you(sg) have_difficulty knowing, therefore explain to me my dream.

10 “Seini ka taheinep ku: Due sabeka ne kayu ne nakita ku diye te elat-elat te kalibutan ne lelayati. 11 Ne migpabulus migtulin ka kayu wey migmaresen, ne ka kalayat kayi nekeume e te langit wey egkakita seini te tagse sabeka kayi te ampew te tane. 12 Mateles ka me dewun kayi wey masulug ka me behas ne eleg ne egkakeen te langun. Ne miggelung ka me mahintalunan ne mananap diye te egkaralungan kayi, wey migsesalag ka me bayaku diye te me sugpang kayi. Ne diye migkuwa te egkakeen ka langun ne eggeheyinawa.

10 “This is my dream: There was one tree that I saw in the middle of the world that was very_tall. 11 And the tree kept growing and becoming_strong, and the height of it reaching the sky/heaven and it could be seen by each on here on top of the earth. 12 Its leaves were beautiful and there were many fruits enough to be eaten by all. And wild animals sheltered in its shade, and birds made their nests in the branches of it. And all that breathe got food from it.

13 “Te ware e pad napukew, due nakita ku ne panalihan[fn] ne migpamaneug puun te langit. 14 Ne migpanguleyi sikandin ne migkahi, ‘Pelera niyu ka kayu wey panempuha niyu ka me sugpang. Awaa niyu ka me dewun wey iregpak niyu ka me behas kayi. Alawa niyu degma ka me mananap ne diye te egkaralungan kayi wey ka me bayaku ne migsesalag diye te me sugpang. 15 Piru kene niyu weila ka tued wey ka me dalid due te kabbenesan, ne egbeleberan te putew wey te burunsi. Ne ka igpasabut te tued iyan sika se etew. Balahara niyu seini ne egkasubid te demmug ne egpuun te langit, wey egpakalemung te me mananap diye te kabbenesan. 16 Seled te pitu ne leg-un, ka suman-suman din isip etew, egkaliwanan te suman-suman te mananap. 17 Ka sika ne peggukum impataha te me panalihan su eyew egpakanengneng ka langun te ka Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama iyan migmandu te migharian te me etew. Ne egkaayun ne igbehey rin seini diye te minsan hentew ne igkeupii rin, minsan te seeye se subla ne mapariralemen te langun ne etew.’ ”

13 “Before I had yet woken, I saw an angel[fn] that descended from heaven/sky. 14 And he/it shouted and said, ‘Fell(pl) the tree and cut_off(pl) the branches. Remove(pl) the leaves and throw_away(pl) the fruit of it. Chase_away(pl) the animals taking_shade here and the bird making_nests in the branches. 15 But don't(pl) move the stump and the roots there in the weeds, that are banded with iron and bronze. And the meaning of the stump is a person. Ignore(pl) this if it/he becomes_wet with dew from the sky/heaven, and (it/he) lives_with the animals there in the weeds. 16 For (LIT inside) seven years, its/his thinking as a person, will_be_replaced_with the thinking of an animal. 17 That judging was_revealed by angels so_that all/everyone can_know that the Very Great God is the (one who) rules the kingdom of people. And it's_possible that he gives this to whoever he wants, even those who are most humble/low of all people.’ ”

18 Ne migpabulus si Hari Nibukadnisar ka migkahi, “Seeye ka taheinep ku Biltisasar, ne kuntee nangeni ad nikeykew te igpasabut kayi su warad iya minsan sabeka te me matagseb kayi te migharian ku ne egpakanangen keddi te igpasabut kayi. Piru egpakaluwas ka kayi tenged su due te keykew ka panisingan te matulus ne me manama.”

18 And King Nebuchadnezzar continued saying, “That was my dream Belteshazzar, and now inform(sg) me what_ this _means because absolutely none even one of the wise(men) here in my kingdom can_inform me what_ this _means. But you(sg) can_interpret this because the spirit of the holy gods is in/with you(sg).”

Ka pegluwas ni Danyil te taheinep te Hari

19 Si Danyil ne egngaranan ded ki Biltisasar, natanengan sikandin te dagdahew su naalatan sikandin meyitenged te taheinep te Hari. Purisu migkahiyan sikandin te Hari, “Biltisasar, kene ka kaalati te taheinep ku wey te igpasabut kayi.”

19 Danyil who was also called Belteshazzar, was_speechless briefly because he was terrified about the dream of the king. Therefore he was spoken to by the king, “Belteshazzar, don't(sg) be terrified by my dream and what_ it _means.”

Ne migtabak si Danyil, “Mahal ne Hari, meupiya perem ke iyan egkasuhat ka me kuntere nu te taheinep nu wey te igpasabut kayi, wey kene ne sikeykew.20 Ka kayu ne nakita nu ne migtulin wey migmalig-en, ne nekeuma diye te langit se kalayat wey egkakita seini te tagse sabeka kayi te ampew te tane, 21 ne mateles se me dewun wey masulug se me behas ne eleg ne egkakeen te langun, wey miggelungan te me mahintalunan ne mananap ka egkaralungan kayi wey migsesalahan te me bayaku ka me sugpang, 22 sikeykew seeye, Mahal ne Hari. Migtulin ka wey migmaresen taman te nekeuma diye te langit ka katelesan nu, wey nekeempet te kalibutan ka peghari nu. 23 Ne nakita nu degma ka panalihan ne migpamaneug puun te langit ne migkahi, ‘Tempuha niyu ka kayu wey dereeti niyu piru balahara niyu re ka tued wey ka dalid diye te tane ne inggiketan te putew wey burunsi. Egbalaharen de due seini ne egkasubid te demmug ne egpuun diye te langit wey egpakalemung te me mahintalunan ne mananap seled te pitu ne leg-un.’

And Danyil answered, “Honored king, it would have_been better if it was your(sg) enemies who were targeted by your(sg) dream and what_ it _means, and not you(sg).20 The tree that you(sg) saw that grew and strengthened, and it's height reached into the sky/heaven and it could be seen by each on here on top of the earth, 21 and the leaves were pretty and there_were many fruit fit for eating by all, and was a sheltering_place for the animals that take_shade there and the branches are nested_in by birds, 22 that is you(sg), honored king. You(sg) have grown and strengthened until your(sg) glory has reached the sky/heaven, and your(sg) kinging has spread_over the world. 23 And you(sg) also saw the angel who descended from heaven/sky and said, ‘Fell(pl) the tree and destroy(pl) it but ignore the stump and the roots there in the ground that are tied with iron and bronze. Ignore this if it gets_wet with dew from the sky/heaven and lives with the wild animals for (LIT inside) seven years.’

24 “Mahal ne Hari, seini ka igpasabut te taheinep nu ne implanu te Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama ne egkeyitabu due te keykew. 25 Egdeldelen ka puun te keet-etawan wey egpakalemung ka te mahintalunan ne me mananap. Egpanabtab kad iling te baka wey egkasubid ka te demmug ne egpuun diye te langit. Eglihad ka pitu ne leg-un ne henduen pad ne eg-ila ka ne ka Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama iyan migmandu te migharian te me etew wey igbehey rin seini diye te minsan hentew ne igkeupii rin. 26 Ne meyitenged te suhu ne egbalaharen de due ka tued te kayu, iyan igpasabut kayi ne egpakalibed ded diye te keykew ka migharian nu te timpu ne eg-ila kad e ne ka Manama[fn] iyan iya migmandu te langun. 27 Purisu, Mahal ne Hari, meupiya perem ke egpamminehen nu seini se tambag ku keykew. Engkeri nud ka peggimu te sale wey matareng e himuwa nu, wey ikeyid-u nu ka egkengaayu-ayu. Ke eggimuwen nu sika, kema ke egpabulus ke pad ka egmatubung.”

24 “Honored king, this is what_was_meant by your(sg) dream that was planned by the Very Great God to happen to you(sg). 25 You(sg) will_be_driven_out from people and will_live(sg) with the wild animals. You(sg) will_graze like cow(s) and you(sg) will_be_wet with dew from the sky/heaven. Seven years will_pass and then you(sg) will_recognize the Very Great God who commands the kingdom of people and (who) gives this to whoever he desires. 26 And concerning the command that the stump of the tree be ignored, what this means is that your(sg) kingdom will_return to you(sg) at the time when you(sg) recognize that God[fn] is the (one who) rules all/everything. 27 Therefore, honored king, it's better if you(sg) listen to this my advice to you(sg). Stop(sg) doing sin and do(sg) righteous (things), and show_mercy to the poor. If you(sg) do that, maybe you(sg) will_continue to have_plenty.”

28 Seeye se langun neyitabu iya diye ki Hari Nibukadnisar. 29 Su peglihad te sabeka ne leg-un, miggiphipanew sikandin diye te atep te palasyu rin ne mapatag diye te Babilunya, 30 wey migkahi, “Amana ne maresen ka Babilunya ne inggimu ku pinaahi te keddi ne kanekal eyew eg-ugpaan te Hari. Pinaahi kayi, egkakita ka karesen ku wey ka kabantug ku.”

28 That all indeed happened to King Nebuchadnezzar. 29 Because after one year, he was walking_around on the roof of his palace that was flat there in Babilunya, 30 and said, “Babilunya that I have made is very great by means of my strength as a residence for the king. By_means_of this, my strength and fame will_be_seen.”

31 Te ware pad nekeimpus ka Hari ka eglalag, due laheng ne egpuun diye te langit ne miggenendue, “Hari Nibukadnisar, pammineg ka te iglalag ku keykew: In-awaan kud sikeykew te katenged isip Hari. 32 Ne egdeldelen ka puun te me etew wey egpakalemung ka te me mahintalunan ne mananap wey egpanabtab kad iling te baka. Ne eglihad ka pitu ne leg-un ne henduen ke pad eg-ila ne ka Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama iyan egmandu te migharian te etew wey igbehey rin seini diye te minsan hentew ne igkeupii rin.”

31 Before the king had_finished speaking, there_was a voice/sound that came from heaven/sky that went, “King Nebuchadnezzar, listen(sg) to what_ I _will_say to you(sg): I will_remove from you(sg) the responsibility as king. 32 And you(sg) will_be_driven_away from people and will_live(sg) with wild animals and graze(sg) like cow(s). And seven years will_pass before you(sg) will_recognize/acknowledge that the Very Great God is (the one who) commands of the kingdom of man and he gives this to whoever he desires.”

33 Due-rue ne neyitabu seeye diye ki Nibukadnisar. Ne indelrel e sikandin puun te me etew wey migpanabtab e sikandin iling te baka. Nasubid sikandin te demmug ne egpuun diye te langit wey migmalayat e ka bulbul rin iling te bulbul te banug wey ka me sulu rin nekeiling e te sulu te bayaku.

33 Immediately that happened to Nebuchadnezzar. And he was driven_away from people and he grazed like a cow. He became_wet with dew from the sky/heaven and his hair lengthened like the hair/feathers of an eagle and his nails like the nails/claws of a bird.

Ka pegdayan ni Nibukadnisar te Manama

The praising of God by Nebuchadnezzar

34 Ne migpabulus si Hari Nibukadnisar ka migkahi, “Te miglihad e ka pitu ne leg-un, migleng-ag a diye te langit wey nakalibed e ka meupiya ne suman-suman ku. Purisu indayan wey insaye ku ka Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama wey intahud ku sikandin se ware egpatayan.

34 And King Nebuchadnezzar continued saying, “When the seven years passed, I looked_up to the sky/heaven and my good thinking returned. Therefore I praised and honored the Very Great God and I respected him who doesn't die.

Ka migharian din ware katamanan,

His kinging has no ending,

wey egpabulus taman te langun ne timpu.

and continues through all time(s).

35 Ne in-isip din ne ware karuan te langun ne nangugpe te tane,

35 And he considers that all who live(pl) on earth have_no value,

wey eggimuwen din ka igkeupii rin

and he does his desire

diye te me panalihan te langit

to the angels in heaven/sky

wey te me etew kayi te tane.

and to the people here on earth.

Ne ware egpakabalabag kandin

Nothing/no one can obstruct him

wey ke egpakapegnel ke nekey ka eggimuwen din.

or reprimand what he is doing.

36 “Te nakalibed e ka meupiya ne suman-suman ku, nakalibed e degma ka keddi ne pegkatalahuren, kabantug, wey katelesan isip Hari. Miglibed e degma keddi ka me upisyal ku wey ka me suluhuanen ku, wey mighari ad e man-e wey migmabantug e pad ne subla. 37 Purisu egdayanen ku, egsayeen, wey egtahuren ku kuntee ka Hari diye te langit tenged su eleg ka langun ne himu rin wey matareng ka me paahi rin. Ne igpariralem din seeye se mapegpeggasal.”

36 “When my good thinking returned, my respect, honor, and beauty as king also returned. My officials also returned to me and my servants, and I reigned again and grew_ extremely more _great. 37 Therefore I honor, praise, and respect now the king there in heaven/sky because everything he does is correct and his ways are righteous. And he humbles those who boast.”

Ka pegsahakeen ni Bilsasar

The feast of Belshazzar (MS Bilsasar)

51 Te iyan e mighari si Bilsasar, migpasahakeen sikandin para te sabeka ne libu te me upisyal rin wey mig-inum sikandin duma kandan. 2 Taheed te egpangiinum e ensi Bilsasar duma te me upisyal rin, te me asawa rin, wey te me duwey rin, impaangey rin e ka me bulawan wey me pelata ne me ubab eyew eg-inuman dan. Seeye ne me ubab, nakuwa te apu[fn] din ne si Nibukadnisar puun diye te timplu te Hirusalim. 3 Purisu in-uyan e ka me bulawan wey pelata ne me ubab diye te kandin wey in-inuman dan e seeye. 4 Ne mig-iinum sikandan wey indeyrey ran ka me manama ne hinimu puun te bulawan, pelata, burunsi, putew, kayu, wey batu.

51 When Belshazzar reigned, he put_on_a_feast for one thousand of his officials and he drank along_with them. 2 While Bilsasar was drinking(pl) along_with his officials, his spouses, and his junior_wives, he sent_for the gold and silver cups in_order_for them to_drink_from. Those cups, were_taken by his grandparent[fn] Nebuchadnezzar from the temple in Hirusalim. 3 Therefore the gold and silver cups were_brought to him and they drank_from these. 4 And they drank and they praised gods made from gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

5 Ne sahuhune ne due belad te etew ne miglepew wey migsulat diye te alabat te palasyu ne diye te marani te tahuanan te sulu, wey nakita seeye te Hari. 6 Migmakalawag ka Hari wey naaldek-haldek sikandin. Migmahuye sikandin wey ingkelkel se buel. 7 Migpanguleyi sikandin ka egpangumew te me timbusawen, te me matagseb ne mammituen, wey te egmahehane. Ne ingkahiyan din ka me matagseb diye te Babilunya, “Ke hentew seeye se egpakabasa te nakasulat sika te alabat wey egpakahuhud te igpasabut due, egpasaluuban ku te mahal ne kumbale,[fn] egpabaliehan te bulawan, wey eggimuwen ku sikandin ne igkatelu ne labew ne talagmandu te migharian ku.” 8 Ne nangingume e diye te Hari ka langun ne me matagseb ne me etew, piru ware sabeka kandan ne egpakabasa wey ke egpakahuhud naa te Hari ke nekey ka igpasabut dutu. 9 Ne nasublaan pad ka kaaldek ni Hari Bilsasar wey migmakalawag pad sikandin ne subla. Ne nalibeg degma ka me upisyal rin.

5 And suddenly there_was a arm/hand of a person that appeared and wrote on the wall of the palace close to the lamp container, and it was_seen by the king. 6 The king yellowed and he was_very_afraid. He felt_weak and (his) knee(s) shook. 7 He shouted calling those_with_spirits, the wise star_readers, and the prophesiers. And he told the wise(men) there in Babilunya, “Whoever can read that which is written on the wall and tell what_ it _means, I will_have_clothed with expensive clothes,[fn] necklaced with gold, and I will_make him the third highest ruler in my kingdom.” 8 And all the wise people came(pl) to the king, but not one of them could read or tell the king what that meant. 9 And King Belshazzar became more afraid and he yellowed more greatly. And his officials were also confused.

10 Te pegkarineg te rayna[fn] te me guhuren dan, miggendiyad e sikandin te insahakeenan dan wey migkahi, “Mahal ne Hari, egkeuyag ka te ware egtamanan. Kene ka kabantali wey kene ka kaaldek.[fn] 11 Kayi te migharian nu, due sabeka ne etew ne diye te kandin ka panisingan te matulus ne me manama. Te timpu pad te apu nu ne si Hari Nibukadnisar, nakitaan seini ne etew te katagseb wey katuenan ne iling te katuenan te me manama. Inggimu sikandin te Hari ne pangulu te me talagbuwas ne egpakaluwas te taheinep, te me timbusawen, te egmahehane, wey te me mammituen. 12 Sikandin si Danyil ne ingngaranan te Hari ki Biltisasar. Due salabutan din wey katuenan ne kene egkeilingan, wey egkateu sikandin ne egluwas te me taheinep, wey egpangguhud te malised ne egnengnengan, wey egkasandihan te mallised ne me prublima. Ipeumew nu si Danyil wey pepangguhud ka kandin te kaluwasan te me lalag ne nasulat sika te alabat.”

10 When the queen[fn] heard their stories, she went to their feast and said, “Honored king, may you(sg) live without ending. Don't(sg) be alarmed and don't(sg) be_afraid.[fn] 11 Here in your(sg) kingdom, there_is a/one person and the spirit of the holy gods is with/in him. In the time still of your(sg) grandparent who was King Nebuchadnezzar, this person was_seen to be wise and with skills/knowledge like the skills/knowledge of the gods. He was_made by the king to be leader of the healers_who_can_interpret_dreams, the ones_with_spirits, the prophesiers, and the star_readers. 12 He is Danyil and named Belteshazzar by the king. He has understanding and skills that are unmatched, and he knows how to interpret dreams, and tell difficult things_to_know, and can_be_depended_on for difficult problems. Send_for Danyil and get_ him _to_tell you(sg) the meaning of the words written on that wall.”

13 Purisu impeumew e te Hari si Danyil. Ne migkahiyan sikandin te Hari, “Sikeykew bes si Danyil ne sabeka te me Hudiyu ne egpuun te Huda ne narakep wey in-uyan te apu ku ne si Nibukadnisar? 14 Nakarineg a ne due te keykew ka panisingan te me manama, wey due katuenan nu te pegnengneng, pegsabut, wey due katagseb nu ne kene egkeilingan. 15 Impeumew kud e ka me matagseb wey me timbusawen eyew igpabasa kandan wey igpaluwas ka nakasulat sika te alabat, piru ware dan nateu. 16 Nakarineg a ne egkateu ke kun ne egluwas wey egkasandihan ke kun degma te mallised ne me prublima. Ne kuntee, ke egkabasa nu wey ke egkaluwas ka igpasabut kayi, egpakumbalaan ku sikeykew te mahal ne kumbale, egpabaliehan te bulawan, wey eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne igkatelu ne labew ne talagmandu te migharian ku.”

13 Therefore the king sent_for Danyil. And he was_spoken to by the king, “So you(sg) are Danyil a/one Hudiyu from Judah who was_captured and brough by my grandparent Nebuchadnezzar? 14 I've heard that the spirit of the gods are with/in you(sg), and you(sg) have skill at knowing, understanding, and you(sg) have wisdom that can't be matched. 15 I sent_for the wise(men) and those_with_spirits so_that it be_read by them and be_interpreted that written on the wall, but they didn't know. 16 I've heard that you(sg) reportedly interpret and you(sg) also can_be_depended_on for difficult problems. So now, if you(sg) can_read and can_interpret the meaning of this, I will_have_ you(sg) _clothed in expensive clothes, necklaced with gold, and I will_make you(sg) the third highest ruler in my kingdom.”

17 Ne migtabak si Danyil, “Mahal ne Hari, keykew e sika se igdasag nu wey ibehey nud e te duma ka ig-unag nu keddi. Piru egbaseen ku red ka nasulat sika te alabat wey egguhuran ku sikeykew te igpasabut kayi.

17 And Danyil answered, “Honored king, your(sg) gift is yours(sg) and give(sg) to others your(sg) reward for_me. But I will_read what's_written on that wall and I'll tell you(sg) what_ it _means.

18 “Mahal ne Hari, ka Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama iyan migbehey te apu nu ne si Nibukadnisar te migharian, kabantug, katelesan, wey karesen. 19 Ne puun te karesen ne imbehey te Manama kandin, nangelkel te kaaldek ka langun ne keet-etawan te nalein-lein ne tribu wey namuun te minsan hendei ne nasud wey linalahan. Eggimatayan din seeye se igkeupii rin te eggimatey wey egkeuyag seeye se igkeupii rin ne egkeuyag. Egbantuhen din seeye se igkeupii rin ne egbantuhen wey igpariralem din seeye se igkeupii rin ne igpariralem. 20 Piru te mighambuhen e sikandin wey migmakehal e se ulu,[fn] impepamaneug e sikandin puun te trunu rin wey in-awaan e sikandin te katelesan din. 21 Indelrel sikandin puun te keet-etawan wey nekeiling e te suman-suman te mananap ka suman-suman din. Ne nakalemung e sikandin te mahintalunan ne me asnu wey migpanabtab e sikandin iling te baka. Nasubid sikandin te demmug ne egpuun diye te langit taman te mig-ile e sikandin ne ka Manama bes ne Amana ne Mabantug iyan egbuut te migharian te me etew wey egpaharien din ka minsan hentew ne igkeupii rin.

18 “Honored king, the Very Great God (was the one who) gave your(sg) grandparent Nebuchadnezzar a/the kingdom, respect, glory, and strength. 19 And from the strength that was_given to him by God, the all people of various tribes and from(pl) whatever nations and languages shook with fear. He kills those he wanted to kill and those he wanted to live lived. He made_great those he wanted to be made_great and humbled those he wanted humbled. 20 But when he became_proud and stubborn (LIT hard in head),[fn] he was_brought_down from his throne and his glory was_removed from him. 21 He was driven_out from the people and his thinking became_like that thinking of animal(s). And he lived_with wild_donkeys and he grazed like a cow. He became_wet with the dew from the sky/heaven until he recognized that the Very Great God (is) the (one who) commands the kingdom of people and he causes_ whoever he wants _to_king.

22 “Ne sikeykew Bilsasar ne apu din, ware ka migmapariralemen minsan nakataha ka te seini se langun. 23 Nasi nu paambuhi ka Magbebaye ne Manama te langit. Impakuwa nu ka me ubab ne egpuun te timplu te Manama wey in-inuman niyu seini te me upisyal nu, te me asawa nu, wey te me duwey nu. Ne insaye nu ka me manama ne inggimu puun te pelata, bulawan, burunsi, putew, kayu, wey batu ne kene egpakakita, kene egpakarineg, wey kene egpakataha. Piru ware nu sayaa ka Manama ne miggen-gen te umul nu wey migbuut te langun ne eggimuwen nu.

22 “And you(sg) Belshazzar his grandchild, you(sg) haven't humbled (yourself) even_though you(sg) know all this. 23 Instead you(sg) boast to the Lord God of heaven/sky. You(sg) had_caused_ the cups _to_be_taken from the temple of God and you(pl) including your(sg) officials, spouses, and your(sg) junior_wives drunk_from_them. And you(sg) praised gods made from silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone that can't see, can't heard, and can't understand. But you(sg) didn't praise the God who holds you(sg) life and decides all that_ you(sg) _do.

24 “Ne diye migpuun te kandin ka belad ne nakita nu ne migsulat te seini ne me lalag, 25 Mini, Mini, Tikil, Parsin. 26 Seini ka igpasabut te sika ne me lalag: Ka Mini, iyan igpasabut se inseel e te Manama ka nasame ne me aldew te migharian nu wey neimpusan e seini. 27 Ka Tikil, iyan igpasabut se nakasuman-suman sikandin ne kene kad e ne eleg ne egmandu.[fn] 28 Ka Parsin, iyan igpasabut se imbaad-baad ka migharian nu wey imbehey e diye te Midiyan wey Pirsya.”

24 “And from his arm/hand that you(sg) saw these words were_written, 25 Mini, Mini, Tikil, Parsin. 26 This is what_ those words _mean: The Mini, means the remaining days of your(sg) kingdom have_been_counted by God and they're finished. 27 The Tikil, means that he's thinking that you(sg) are no_longer fit to command.[fn] 28 The Parsin, means your(sg) kingdom is divided_up and given to the Medians and the Persians.”

29 Seeye de iya, migsuhu si Bilsasar ne egpasaluuban si Danyil te mahal ne kumbale wey egpabaliehan te bulawan. Ne migsuhu si Bilsasar ne egpakahiyan ka me etew te si Danyil ka igkatelu ne labew ne talagmandu diye te migharian din.

29 Just then, Belshazzar commanded that Danyil be_dressed in expensive clothe(s) and necklaced with gold. And Belshazzar commanded that the people be_told that Danyil was the third highest ruler in his kingdom.

30 Te seeye de ne karusileman, innimatayan e si Bilsasar ne Hari te Babilunya. 31 Ne si Daryu ne matig-Midiya ne hen-em e ne pulu wey daruwa (62) ne leg-un se kabuyahi, iyan nakaahew te migharian.

30 That very night, Belshazzar the king of Babilunya was_killed. 31 And Darius (MS Daryu) from_Midiyan who was sixty-two (62) years old, he snatched the kingdom.

Ka peg-ulug ki Danyil diye te me liyun

The dropping of Danyil into the lions

61 Nataman, mig-alam si Hari Daryu te 120 ne me gubirnadur ne iyan egmandu te migharian din. 2 Ne mig-alam ka Hari te tatelu ne me pangulu eyew iyan egpangulu te seeye ne me gubirnadur su eyew kene egkeyimu ne ware pulus te me planu rin. Ne sabeke en iya si Danyil te seeye se tatelu ne me pangulu. 3 Ne si Danyil iyan labew te langun ne pangulu tenged te katuenan din ne kene egkeilingan, purisu migsuman-suman ka Hari ne si Danyil ka egpeuyanen te intiru ne migharian din. 4 Tenged dutu, migpamitew ka duma rin ne me pangulu wey ka me gubirnadur te seyyup din te peg-uyan din diye te migharian eyew igpakasumbung dan sikandin diye te Hari. 81 Te ikatelu ne leg-un te peghari ni Bilsasar, duen e man-e impakita te Manama keddi. 2 Diye te impakita keddi, diye e kun te ilis te weyig ne egngaranan te Ulay ne diye te Susa. But one (LIT other) horn was longer, and the other was shorter, and the longer (one), had sprouted later. 4 And I saw the sheep butted toward the west, and to the north (LIT left side), and to the south (LIT right side). 5 Taheed te migsuman-suman a meyitenged dutu, sahuhune ne due miglepew ne lukesan ne kambing puun te iglineb. Innipanew rin ka intiru ne kalibutan ne ware nakaragket se paa te tane. Seeye ne kambing, due sabsabeka ne sungey diye te elat-elat te mata rin ne egpekeinniyat ne egpitawen. 6 Ne indula rin seeye se karniru ne daruwa se sungey ne nakita ku ne diye migsasindeg te ilis te weyig. Ne amana sikandin nabelu-belu te pegdula rin. 7 Te neumaan din e ka karniru, indula rin e patamtamani taman te nahepu e ka daruwa ne sungey kayi. Ne warad keseg te karniru te pegkuntere kandin wey napeled e seini diye te tane wey indi-diekan e te kambing. Warad iya sabeka ne nakapangabang te karniru puun te geem te kambing.

5 While I was thinking about that, suddenly there_was a male goat that came from the west. It went to the entire world but (its) feet didn't touch the ground. That goat, had just_one horn in the middle of its eyes that was desiring to be_seen. 6 And it butted that sheep with two horns that I saw standing at the edge of the water. And it was_ very _angry in its butting. 7 When he got to the sheep, he butted (it) intensely until its two horns were broken. And the sheep had no_more strength for opposing and it fell to the ground and was trampled by the goat. No one at_all could_help the sheep from the power of the goat.

8 Ne amana migpegpeggasal te pegkeetew rin ka kambing. Piru te subla rin e ne migmaresen, natempug e ka sungey rin. Piru due lein ne hep-at ne sungey ne migsubal migtubu ne egpekeinniyat ne egpitawen, wey diye nakatinuru te hep-at ne pikungan te kalibutan. 9 Diye te sabeka ne sungey, due migtubu ne deisek ne sungey wey migmaresen amana diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan, wey diye te igsile, wey diye te tane te Israil.[fn] 10 [xr]Migmaresen pad iya seini taman te impangulug e kayi ka duma ne me sundalu diye te langit wey me bituen. Ne indi-diekan din e seini. 11 Migpeggasal sikandin ne madmaresen pad du te Pangulu te me sundalu diye te langit. Impasanggel rin ka aldew-aldew ne egtutungen ne pegpanubad wey indereetan din ka timplu. 12 Tenged te pegsupak din, imbehey e diye kandin ka me sundalu diye te langit wey ka aldew-aldew ne pegpanubad. 8 And the goat greatly boasted about itself. But while it was extremely powerful, its horn snapped_off. But there were another four horns that grew to replace (it) that desired to be_seen, and pointed there to the four corners of the world. 9 There on one horn, a small horn sprouted and became very strong there in the south (LIT right side), and in the east, and there in the land of Israil.[fn] 10 [xr]It became stronger until it threw_down some soldiers from heaven/sky and stars. And it trampled them. 11 It boasted that it was stronger than the Leader of the soldiers in heaven/sky. It caused_the_stopping of the daily burnt offering and it destroyed the temple. 12 Due to its resistance/disobedience, the soldiers in heaven/sky and the daily sacrifice were_given to it. And it rejected (LIT threw) the truth[fn] and it prospered in all that it did.

13 Ne nakarineg a te daruwa ne panalihan ne migpalalahey. Ka sabeka mig-inse diye te dangeb, “Ken-u buwa egkabunsuri egkeyitabu ka seeye se impakita te Manama wey kamenu buwa kaluhey? Ken-u buwa egkeimpusi ka pegpasanggel te aldew-aldew ne pegtutung te igpanubad, wey te pegsupak ne egpakarereet, wey te peg-ahew te timplu, wey te pegleig-leig te me sundalu diye te langit?”

13 And I heard two angels talking_together. One asked the other, “When maybe will that revealed by God begin to happen and how long will_it_go_for? When maybe will the stopping of the daily burnt offerings finish, and the disobedience that destroys, and the snatching of the temple, and the mocking of the soldiers in heaven/sky?”

14 Ne migtabak kandin ka dangeb ne panalihan, “Eggingumaan seini seled te 2,300 ne aldew wey marusilem, ne egkataman eglinisan e ka timplu.”

14 And the other angel answered him, “This will_last for (LIT come inside) 2,300 days and nights, and then the temple will_be_cleaned.”

15 Taheed te egpipitew a te seeye se impakita te Manama keddi wey migpalemlem ke nekey ka igpasabut kayi, sahuhune ne due migsasindeg diye te tangkaan ku ne egpekeiling te etew. 16 [xr]Ne due laheng te etew ne narineg ku puun te Ulay ne weyig ne miggenendue, “Gabriil, ipasabut nu kandin ke nekey ka igpasabut te impakita te Manama kandin.” 17 Ne migparani si Gabriil keddiey, ne naaldek a wey miglangkeb a. 20 “Ka lukesan ne karniru ne daruwa se sungey ne nakita nu, iyan impahunsilingan te me Hari te Midiyan wey Pirsya. 21 Ka lukesan ne kambing iyan ka Hari te Grisya, wey ka dakel ne sungey ne diye te elat-elat te mata rin iyan ka an-anayan ne Hari. 22 Ne seeye se hep-at ne sungey ne migsubal migtubu te seeye se natempug ne sungey, iyan ka hep-at ne migharian ne migpuun te nasud te an-anayan ne Hari. 20 “The male sheep with two horns that you(sg) saw, that represents the kings of Media and Persia. 21 The male goat that's the king of Greece, and the large horn in the middle of its eyes that the first king. 22 Those four horns that sprouted to replace that broken_off horn, (are) the four kingdoms that come_from the nation of the first king. 23 “Te katammanan te peghari dan, te timpu ne suble e amana ka pegpakasale dan, eghari e degma ka sabeka ne Hari ne mabulut, mareet, wey mangngateu ne egpanlimbung. 24 Egkeyimu sikandin ne amana ne maresen piru kene ne tenged te kandin iya ne karesen. Ne masulug ka me etew ne egtigkawen din egpangimatayi, wey eg-ehetan din ka Pangulu te me pangulu. Piru egdereetan sikandin, kene ne pinaahi te geem te etew, ke kene, te geem te Manama. 26 Egkatuman iya ka impakita te Manama keykew ne pegpeengked te maselem wey maapun[fn] ne pegpanubad, piru kene nu pa seini ipangguhud te minsan hentew su mananey mem pad seini egkeyitabu.”

23 “At the end of their kinging, at the time when their sins are extremely great, there will_ also _be one king who will_reign who is fierce, evil, and skilled at cheating. 24 He will_become very strong but not from his own strength. And his destroying_things will_be_frightening and he will_succeed in all he does. He will_destroy the strong people and the people of God. 25 Due to his skills, he will_succeed at cheating and he will_praise himself. Ka peg-ampu ni Danyil para te keet-etawan din

The praying by Danyil for his people

91 Te seeye ne timpu, si Daryu ne matig-Midiya ne anak ni Aswiru iyan Hari te intiru ne Babilunya. 2 [xr]Te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari din, sikeddi si Danyil, imbasa kud ka me baseen, ne due baseen dutu ne impakita te Magbebaye ne Manama diye ki prupita Hirimiyas. 91 At that time, Darius from_Media the child of Aswiru was the king of entire Babilunya. 2 [xr]In the first year of his kinging, I Danyil, I read the documents, and there_was a document there that was_revealed by the Lord God to the prophet Hirimiyas. 3 Ne dutu, migpangananey a te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te peg-ampu, pegpuasa, wey pegsaluub te saku[fn] wey pegpamukbuk te abu te ulu ku. 4 Mig-ampu a wey migpangguhud a te me sale ney ne miggenendue, “He, Magbebaye ne Manama, maresen ka wey igkaaldek ne Manama. Intuman nu ka me saad nu wey impapitew nu te geyinawa ne kene egkabalbalawan seeye se miggeyinawa keykew wey migtuman te me suhu nu. 5 Nakasale key keykew te peggimu ney te mareet wey te pegsupak ney keykew, wey te pegbalahad ney te me suhu nu wey balaud. 6 Ware key migpammineg te me suluhuanen nu ne me prupita, ne insuhu nu ne egpakiglalag te me Hari ney, te me pangulu ney, te me kabuybuyahan ney, wey te langun ne etew te nasud. 7 Matareng ka, Magbebaye, piru mekeyilew-hilew key mule minsan kuntee. Mekeyilew-hilew key langun ne me etew lagkes ka keet-etawan te Huda wey te Hirusalim, wey ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne intalagtag nu diye te marani wey diye te mariyu ne me inged tenged te pegsupak dan keykew. 8 Mekeyilew-hilew key Magbebaye ne Manama lagkes ka me Hari ney, ka me pangulu ney, wey ka me kabuybuyahan ney tenged su nakasale key keykew.

3 So then, I requested of the Lord God by_means_of praying, fasting, and dressing in sacks[fn] and sprinkling ash on my head. 4 I prayed and I storied him of our(excl) sins going, “Oh, Lord God, you(sg) are strong and fearful God. You(sg) fulfill your(sg) promises and you(sg) showed unchangeable love to those who love you(sg) and obey your(sg) commands. 5 We(excl) have_sinned_against you(sg) in our(excl) doing evil and in our(excl) disobeying you(sg), and in our(excl) ignoring your(sg) commands and law. 6 We(excl) haven't listened to your(sg) servants the prophets, that you(sg) commanded to speak to our(excl) kings, to our(excl) leaders, to our(excl) elders, and to all the people in the nation. 7 You(sg) are righteous, Lord, but we(excl) are shameful even now. We(excl) all the people including the people of Judah and of Hirusalim are shameful, and the descendants of Israil that you(sg) spread_out in nearby and distant places due to their disobeying you(sg). 8 We(excl) are shameful Lord God including our(incl) kings, leaders, and our(incl) elders because we(excl) have_sinned_against you(sg).

9 “Piru hiid-uwen wey mapasayluwen ka, Magbebaye ne Manama minsan se migsupak key keykew. 10 Ware key migpammineg keykew wey ke migtuman naa te me balaud nu ne imbehey nu kanami pinaahi te me suluhuanen nu ne me prupita. 11 Migsupak ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil te balaud nu, wey migpariyu key e, wey ware ney tumana ka inlalag nu. Tenged te pegpakasale ney, neyingumaan key te pegdilus wey peggukum ne nasulat diye te Balaud ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen nu. 12 Intuman nu ka ingkahi nu kanami wey te me pangulu ney, ne egpasalerepen key nikeykew te masumpit. 9 “But you(sg) are merciful and forgiving, Lord God even though we(incl) disobey you(sg). 10 We(excl) haven't listened to_you(sg) or obeyed your(sg) laws that you(sg) gave us(excl) by_means of your(sg) servants the prophets. 11 All the descendants of Israil have disobeyed your(sg) laws, and we(excl) have distanced (ourselves), and we(excl) haven't obeyed what_ you(sg) _said. 15 “Na kuntee, sikeykew ka Magbebaye ne Manama ney, ne iyan migluwas te keet-etawan nu puun te Ihiptu pinaahi te geem nu, wey neyimu ka ne mabantug taman kuntee. Para keykew Manama ku, kene kad lamu-lamu tenged su ka siyudad nu wey ka keet-etawan nu, ingngaran ma te ngaran nu.”

15 “So_then now, you(sg) are our(excl) Lord God, who saved your(sg) people from Ihiptu by_means of your(sg) power, and you(sg) became famous (LIT great) until the_present. But we(excl) sinned and did (what was) extremely bad. 16 From your(sg) righteousness, have_pity on us(excl) and remove your(sg) anger and wrath from Hirusalim, your(sg) city there on the holy mountain. 20 Migpabulus a ka eg-ampu wey egpangguhud te sale ku wey te sale te keet-etawan ku ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Migpangananey a te Magbebaye ne Manama ku ne igpalibed din ded igpasasindeg ka matulus ne bubungan din. 21 [xr]Taheed te eg-ampu e pad, nakita ku si Gabriil ne miglayang peendini te keddi. He (was) the (one who) I had_seen before in my dream. That was the time of the afternoon sacrificing. 22 He approached me and said, “Danyil, I have come in_order that you(sg) will_understand and will_know about what_ God _has_shown to you(sg). 23 When you(sg) had just begun to request_help from God, you(sg) were already answered by_him. 24 “Ingkerew te Manama ne 490 ne leg-un ne egkataman e ka peggimu te sale te me etew wey te matulus ne siyudad din. Egpasayluwen e sikandan eyew igpeyingume e te Manama ka katareng ne ware egtamanan, wey eyew egkapamalehetan e ka impakita te Manama wey ka inlalag te prupita, wey eyew igpakahalad e man-e ka timplu te Manama.[fn] 25 Keilangan ne egkatahaan nu wey egkasabut nu ne eglihad pad ka 49 ne leg-un puun te pegkahi te Manama ne igpasasindeg ded ka Hirusalim, taman te eglepew e ka in-alam din. Ne eglihad pad man-e ka 434 ne me leg-un human egpakasasindeg ka Hirusalim ne due plasa wey matikang wey maluag ne alad ne batu. Piru timpu seini te due samuk. 26 Pegkeimpus te sika ne me leg-un, eggimatayan e ka in-alam te Manama wey hendue te ware neimpusan din. Piru te peglihad te tatelu ne leg-un wey liware, egpasanggelen din ka pegpanubad wey peghalad. Ne egtahu sikandin te sabeka ne makaalat-halat ne ‘talagdereet ne lilinditi’ diye te timplu. Egpabulus seini taman te eggingume e ka katammanan ne intahahe te Manama kandin.”

But after three years and a half, he will_have_stopped the sacrificing and offering. And he will_put a (LIT one) terrifying ‘dirty destroying (one)’ there in the temple. This will_continue until the end arrives which God has prepared for him.”

Ka makaaldek-haldek ne impakita te Manama ki Danyil

The terrifying (thing or person) that God revealed to Danyil

101 Te ikatelu e ne leg-un te peghari ni Hari Siru diye te Pirsya, due lalag ne impanengneng ki Danyil ne migngaranan ded ki Biltisasar. Malehet seeye wey meyitenged te dakel ne gubut. Nasabut seeye ni Danyil su impakita ma te Manama seeye kandin.

101 In the third year of the kinging by King Cyrus in Persia, there_was a word/message made_known to Danyil also named Belteshazzar. It was true and about a large war. Danyil understood it because it had been_revealed to him by God.

2 Te seeye ne timpu, sikeddi si Danyil, miglungku seled te tatelu ne simana. 3 Wara a migkeen te mananam ne egkakeen wey wara ad iya miggeram te ngalap wey ke binu naa. Wara a degma migpanahu te peemut diye te lawa ku seled te tatelu ne simana.

2 At that time, I Danyil, mourned for (LIT inside) three weeks. 3 I didn't eat delicious food and I didn't try meat/fish or wine. I also didn't put_on perfume on my body for (LIT inside) three weeks.

4 Te igkararuwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan, taheed te migsasindeg a diye te ilis te dakel ne Weyig ne Tigris, 5 [xr]due nakita ku ne etew ne migsaluub te hinabel wey migtetabed te neelin ne bulawan. 6 Egpekeiling ka lawa rin te mahal ne batu ne egngaranan te biril wey egpekeiling kasil-ew te kilat ka ulaula rin. Ne ka mata rin egpekeiling te migsiha ne me sulu wey ka belad din wey ka paa rin egpekeiling te impasilak ne burunsi. Ka laheng din egpekeiling te laheng te masulug ne etew.

4 On the twenty-fourth (24) day of the first month, while I stood at the edge of the large Tigris river, 5 [xr]I saw a person dressed of cloth and belted with all gold. 6 His body was like an expensive stone named biril and his face glowed like lightning. And his eyes were_like shining lights and his arm/hand(s) and his feet/leg(s) were_like polished bronze. His voice was like the sound of many people.

7 Sikeddi de ka nakakita te impakita te Manama wey ware mule ka me duma ku. Piru inningumaan sikandan te liyas, sikan naa ka namallahuy e sikandan wey miggeles. 8 Purisu sikeddi naan de ka nasame wey ka nakakita te kein-inuwan ne impakita te Manama. Ne dutu, nawaraan ad te keseg wey migmakalawag e ka ulaula ku. 9 Ne narineg ku ka etew ne miglalag. Taheed te migpammineg a kandin, napeled a wey warad kaligneepan ku te nakalangkeb diye te tane. 10 Ne dutu, due migsamsam keddi ne iyan egpuunan ne nakapanimbuel a wey nakatukud se me belad ku diye te tane ne egkelkelen pad.

7 (It was) just me who could_see what_ God _revealed and not [contrary particle] my companions. While I listened to him, I fell_down and I had no consciousness lying_face_down on the ground. 10 And then, there_was someone (who) touched me and that's the reason that I was_able_to_kneel and was supported by my arms there still shaking on the ground.

11 Ne ingkahiyan a nikandin, “Danyil ne inggeyinawaan amana te Manama, sasindeg ka wey pammineha nu ay-ayari ke nekey ka iglalag ku keykew su impeuyan a kayi keykew.” Te peglalag din kayi keddi, migsasindeg ad ne egkelkelen pad.

11 And he said to me, “Danyil who is greatly loved by God, stand(sg) and listen(sg) carefully to what_ I _have to say to_you(sg) because I was_sent here to_you(sg).” Upon his saying this to_me, I stood_up and was still shaking.

12 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Kene ka kaaldek Danyil, su puun pad te an-anayan ne aldew te peggeram nu te pegsabut wey te pegpariralem te pegkeetew nu diye te tangkaan te Manama, indineg e ka pegpangananey nu. Miggendini a isip tabak te pegpanganey nu. 13 [xr]Imbalabahan a te mareet ne panalihan ne migbulig te Pirsya[fn] seled te daruwa ne pulu wey sabeka (21) ne aldew. Ne nataman, miggingume e si Migil ka egbulig keddi—sabeka sikandin te me pangulu te me panalihan. Ne in-engkeran ku sikandin diye duma te mareet ne panalihan ne migbulig te Pirsya. 14 Ne kuntee, miggendini a eyew te pegpasabut keykew meyitenged te egkeyitabu keureme te me karumaan nu te Israilita. Su meyitenged te egkeyitabu keureme ka impakita te Manama.”

12 And he said, “Don't(sg) be_afraid Danyil, because from the first day of your(sg) of trying to understand and of lowering your(sg) self in front of God, your(sg) requesting was_heard. I came as an answer to your(sg) requesting. 13 [xr]I was blocked by the bad angel that helped Persia[fn] for (LIT inside) twenty-one (21) days. And then, Michael (MS Migil) came to_help me—he is one of the leaders of the angels. And I left_ him _behind there along_with the bad angel that helped Persia. 14 And now, I came_here in_order for causing_ you(sg) _to_understand about what_will_happen in_the_future to your(sg) relatives the Israilitas. Because what_ God _revealed is about what_will_happen in_the_future.”

15 Te peglalag din dutu, mig-usengul a wey neummew. 16 Ne due hendue te etew ne migsamsam te bibig ku, ne nakalalag ad e. Diye sikandin migsasindeg te tangkaan ku wey migkahiyan ku sikandin, “Ahalen, amana ne mareet ka eggeramen ku wey nawaraan a te keseg tenged te nakita ku. 17 Na, egmemenu e naa se suluhuanen nu ne egpakiglalag keykew te warad ma keseg ku wey hendue te kena ad egpakaheheyinawa?”

15 At his saying this, I looked_down and was_dumb. 16 And there_was (one) like a person who touched my lip(s), and I could speak. He stood there by my front and I said to him, “Master, I feel really bad and I've lost (my) strength due to what_ I _saw. 17 So_then, what_ can I your(sg) servant _do speaking to_you(sg) without my strength and as if I can't breathe?”

18 Ne insamsam ad man-e te seeye se hendue te etew wey imbehayan a nikandin te keseg. 19 Migkahi sikandin, “Inggeyinawaan ka amana te Manama, purisu kene ka kaaldek wey ka keupianan egduma keykew. Pakannekal ka wey bagget-bagget ka.”

18 And I was touched again by that (one who is) like a person and I was_given strength by_him. 19 He said, “You(sg) are greatly loved by God, therefore don't(sg) be_afraid and may peace/prosperity accompany you(sg). Be(sg)_strong and be(sg)/_enthusiastic.”

Te nalalag din e seeye, migmanekal ad wey migkahi, “Lalag ke pa ahalen su imbehayan a nikeykew te keseg.”

When he had said that, I grew_stronger and said, “Speak(sg) more master because I've been_given strength by_you(sg).”

20 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Keilangan ne eglibed a egpakig-ehet te mareet ne panalihan ne migbulig te Pirsya. Te egpekeimpus ad ka egpakig-ehet, egginguma ka panalihan ne migbulig te Grisya. Piru nakataha ke naa ke mania te miggendini a keykew? 21 Iyan ku innendini ka egnangen keykew ke nekey ka nasulat te libru te kamalehetan. Na, te timpu ne migpakig-ehet a te seeye se maddeet ne panalihan, warad iya lein ne migbulig keddi, ke kene, si Migil re iya—ka panalihan ne migtameng te Israil.

20 And he said, “It's_necessary that I return to attack the evil angel that helps Persia. When I've finished attacking, the angel that helps Greece will_arrive. But do you(sg) know why I came_here to_you(sg)? 21 The (reason) I came_here was to tell you(sg) what is written in the book of truth. So_then, at the time that I attacked that evil angel, no (one) else helped me, except, just Migil indeed—the angel that watches_over Israil.

111 Te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari ni Daryu ne matig-Midiya, sikeddi mismu ka migbulig wey miglig-en ki Migil.”

111 In the first year of the kinging by Darius from_Media, I myself (was the one who) helped and strengthened Migil.”

Ka me Hari te Ihiptu wey Sirya

The kings of Ihiptu and Syria

2 “Ne kuntee igpanengneng ku keykew ka malehet: duen pad tatelu ne Hari ne eghari diye te Pirsya, ne duen pad igkeep-at ne subla pad ne meyaman du te duma. Te egmaresen e sikandin pinaahi te karatuan din, egbaggeten din ka langun te pegkuntere te migharian te Grisya. 3 Ne due egginguma dutu ne maresen ne Hari ne egmandu te dakel ne migharian wey eggimu te minsan nekey sumale te igkeupii rin. 4 Te egmaresen e sikandin, egkareetan e ka migharian din wey egkabaad e seini te hep-at ne baad, piru kene ne kabuhalan din ka egsubal kandin eghari. Ne ka me Hari ne egsubal kandin, kenad egpekeiling kandin karesen. Ka malehet, eg-aween e ka migharian din wey igpamehey e seini diye te duma.

2 “And now I will_explain to you(sg) the truth: there are still three kings who will_reign in Persia, and there_is still a fourth who is very much wealthier than the others. When he becomes_strong by_means_of his riches, he will_encourage all in opposing the kingdom of Greece. 3 And there_is a strong king who will_arrive there and rule (command) a large kingdom and do whatever according to his desire. 4 When he becomes_strong, his kingdom will_be_destroyed and it will_be_divided into four portions, but it will_ not _be_his descendant(s) that replace him in reigning. And the kings who replace him, won't be like him in strength. The truth (is), his kingdom will_be_removed and it will_be_distributed to other(s).

5 “Ne ka Hari te Ihiptu, egmaresen e piru due sabeka te me upisyal rin ne egmadmaresen pad kandin wey eghari te dakel ne peghari. 6 Peglihad te masulug ne me leg-un, eggimu te kasabutan ka Hari te Ihiptu wey ka Hari te Sirya. Igpaasawa te Hari te Ihiptu ka anak din ne malitan te Hari te Sirya isip tuus te kasabutan. Piru kene egkaluhey ka sika ne pegsabeka su eggimatayan ma ka malitan lagkes ka iglukes wey ka anak. Ne lagkes degma ka me suluhuanen ne migduma kandin. 7 Te seeye ne me timpu, sabeka te me karumaan te malitan ka egkeyimu ne Hari diye te Ihiptu. Eglusuran din ka Sirya wey eglasuran din ka malig-en ne ugpaan te Hari wey egkareeg din sikandan. 8 Eg-uyanen din diye te Ihiptu ka me larawan ne me manama ran wey ka me mahal ne ubab dan ne hinimu puun te bulawan wey pelata. Seled te pila ne leg-un kene sikandin eglusud te Hari te Sirya. 9 Ne egkataman, eglusuran te Hari te Sirya ka migharian te Ihiptu, piru egpekeuli de sikandin te nasud din.

5 “And the king of Ihiptu, will_strengthen but there will_be_one of his officials that will_become_somewhat_stronger than him and will_reign_over a large kinging. 6 After many years have passed, the king of Ihiptu and the king of Syria will_make an agreement. The king of Ihiptu will_give_in_marriage his female child to the king of Syria as a sign of (the) agreement. But that uniting won't last_long because the woman will_be_killed including her husband and child. And also including the servants who accompanied her. 7 At that time, one relative of the woman will_become the king in Ihiptu. He will_attack Syria and he will_attack the strong residence of the king and he will_defeat them. 8 He will_take the images of their gods to Ihiptu and their expensive cups made from gold and silver. For (LIT inside) a few years he won't invade the king of Syria. 9 And finally, the king of Syria will_invade the kingdom of Ihiptu, but he will_ just _have_to_return_home to his nation.

10 “Ne egpangandam ka me anak ne me lukes te Hari te Sirya te pegbubunu wey eglibulung te susuluhi ne me sundalu. Eglusud sikandan ne egpekeiling te baggiyu ne kene egkapahenan taman diye te malig-en ne ugpaan te me kuntere. 11 Tenged te kabelu te Hari te Ihiptu, egsukul sikandin te Hari te Sirya wey egkatalu rin ka masulug ne me sundalu kayi. 12 Te natalu rin e ka susuluhi ne me sundalu, egpegpeggasal e sikandin wey libu-libu pad ka egpangimatayan din. 10 “And the male children of the king of Syria will_prepare(pl) for war and will_assemble very_many soldiers. They will_invade like a flood that can't_be_held_back until (reaching) the strong residence of (their) enemies. 11 Due to the anger of the king of Ihiptu, he will_resist the king of Syria and he will_defeat the many soldiers. 12 When he has defeated the many soldiers, he will_boast and he will_kill thousands more. 13 “Peglihad te pila ne me leg-un, impamasalug pad te Hari te Sirya ka me sundalu rin du te seeye se an-anayan. Ne migpatetamundu te tane ka me sundalu rin diye te impabunsuran te alad eyew egkabayaan dan te eglusud. Ne kene egpakasukul ka me sundalu te Ihiptu wey minsan seeye se me bahani su warad keseg dan ne igpakasukul. 16 Purisu sikandin se miglusud te Hari te Ihiptu eggimu te minsan nekey ne igkeupii rin wey ware iya egpakasukul kandin. Ne minsan ka Israil, ka Mateles ne Tane ne insaad te Manama, egsakupen din pad iya wey due geem din te pegdereet kayi.

13 “After some years have passed, the king of Syria will_increase his soldiers compared to those at first. 17 “Egplanu ka Hari te Sirya te peglusud te Ihiptu ne eggamiten ka langun ne me sundalu rin.
