17 “The king of Syria will_plan to invade Ihiptu using all of his soldiers. He will_unite with and he will_marry_off his female child to the king of Ihiptu in_order for destroying his kingdom but the king of Syria won't prosper/succeed. 18 And then, he will_attack (those) living(pl) at the edge of the sea and he will_make_subjects of many of these. But he will_lose to one leader who will_cause_ his ridiculing _to_stop and will_cause_ his ridiculing _to_return to him. 19 Therefore he will_return_home to his own place that's surrounded by a strong fence. But he will_lose and that indeed will_be_his ending.

20 “Ka egsubal kandin ne Hari egsuhu te sabeka ne etew ne egpamehes te pegpabayad te buwis eyew egkatimulan ka karatuan te migharian din. Piru seled te pila ne me aldew egkapatey sikandin piru kene ne pinaahi te belu wey ke gubut naa.”

20 “The (one who) replaces him will_command one person to persuade the levying (LIT causing_to_pay) of taxes so_that the wealth of his kingdom will_be_added_to. But within (LIT inside) a few days he will_die but not due to anger or war.”

Ka mareet ne Hari te Sirya

The bad/evil king of Syria

21 “Ka egsubal man-e kandin, ware pulus ne etew wey ware katenged ne egkeyimu ne Hari. Egtigkew sikandin eglepew wey eg-angkenen din ka migharian pinaahi te peggulu. 22 Masulug ne sundalu ka egguleen din te egpangimatey lagkes ka pangulu te me talagpanubad. 23 Puun te timpu te migpakigsabeka sikandin te duma ne me nasud, migpanlimbung e sikandin wey egkeyimu sikandin ne maresen duma te pila-pila ne me etew rin. 24 Egtigkawen din te eglusud ka matubung ne inged diye te prubinsya wey eggimuwen din ka ware neyimu te kabuybuyahan din dengan. Egba-baaren din diye te me sakup din ka langun ne naahew rin puun te bunuanan. Egsuman-suman sikandin ne eglusud te me lungsud ne due malig-en ne alad. Piru seini se langun kene egkaluhey.

21 “The (one who) again replaces him, will_be_a worthless person and without authority to become king. He will suddenly appear and he will_receive his kingdom by_means of enticing. 22 He will_annihilate many soldiers by killing (them) including the leader of the sacrificers. 23 From the time that he unites with other nations, he will_cheat_repeatedly and he will_become strong along_with his few people. 24 He will suddenly invade the prosperous place in the province and he will_do what his elder(s) never did before. He will_divide_up what he snatches in fighting among his followers. He will_consider invading towns that have strong fence(s). But this all won't take_long.

25 “Duma te masulug ne me sundalu rin, migbagget-bagget sikandin ka egkuntere te Ihiptu. Piru egsukul kandan ka Hari te Ihiptu duma te masulug wey malig-en ne me sundalu. Piru egkatalu ka Hari te Ihiptu tenged su eglimbungan sikandin te Hari te Sirya. 26 Sakup din mismu ka egdereet kandin, purisu egkatalu ka me sundalu rin wey masulug kandan ka egpatey. 27 Eg-atubang seini se daruwa ne Hari piru ka tagse sabeka egpakannekal ne egsuman-suman te mareet wey egpeub-ubatey sikandan se daruwa. Te diye din e te deralanen, egtulan sikandin diye te tane te Israil, wey egdereetan din ka eleg ne pegsimba te Manama. Eggimuwen din ka igkeupii rin, ne henduen pad sikandin egleus diye te inged din.

25 “Along with his many soldiers, he will_look_forward to opposing Ihiptu. But the king of Ihiptu will_resist him with many and strong soldiers. But the king of Ihiptu will_lose because he will_be_cheated by the king of Siria. 26 His own follower(s) will_destroy him, therefore his soldiers will_lose and many of them will_die(pl). 27 These two kings will_face_up but each one will_strive to think of evil and the two of them will_lie_to_each_other. While he's still on the trail, he will_call_in to the land of Israil, and he will_destroy the correct worshiping of God. He will_do what he wants, before he will_continue to his place.

29 “Te intahahe ne timpu, eglibed e man-e ka Hari te Sirya diye Ihiptu eyew te peglusud kayi, piru ka egkeyitabu, kenad e ne iling te an-anayan. 30 Su egmanguntud te barku ka me matig-Ruma ka egpakig-ehet te Hari te Sirya wey egkaliyasan sikandin. Eg-aween din ka aldew-aldew ne pegpanubad wey egtahuan din te sabeka ne makaalat-halat ne ‘talagdereet ne lilinditi.’ 32 Egguluan din seeye se ware migtuman te matulus ne kasabutan. Piru ka me etew ne nekeila te Manama ran, maresen ne egpakig-ehet kandin. 33 Ka seeye se me matagseb, migbulig ne egpasabut te masulug ne etew minsan egpangimatayan sikandan pinaahi te kampilan wey ke egtutungen naa. 29 “At the prepared time, the king of Syria will_return again to Ihiptu in_order to invade it, but what_will_happen, will_ not _be_like the first (time). 30 Because the (ones) from_Ruma will_ride(pl) ship(s) to attack the king of Syria and he will_be_fearful. 36 [xra][xrb]“Eggimuwen te Hari te Sirya ke nekey ka igkeupii rin. Migpeggasal sikandin te pegkeetew ne labew sikandin te langun ne manama wey miglalag sikandin te makaaldek-haldek ne pegbaley-baley kuntere te Manama ne labew te langun ne me manama. Eghalaran din te bulawan, pelata, mahal ne me batu, wey duma pad ne mahal ne me dasag. 39 Eglusuran din ka me siyudad ne nalingutan te mallig-en ne me alad pinaahi te pegbulig te lapu ne manama. Ne egkabantug seeye se me etew ne migdawat kandin. Eggimuwen din sikandan ne me talagmandu te masulug ne me etew wey egbehayan din sikandan te tane isip dasag.

36 [xra][xrb]“The king of Syria will_do whatever he wants. He will_boast of himself above all god(s) and he will_say terrifying (things) blaspheming against God who is above all gods. 40 “Te timpu te katammanan, egpakig-ehet ka Hari te Ihiptu te Hari te Sirya. Piru egsukul kandin ka Hari te Sirya duma te langun ne geem din wey eggamit sikandin te me kerumata, me kudde, wey me barku. Piru egpakapallahuy ka Idum, ka Muwab, wey ka me pangulu te Amunihanen. 42 Eglusuran din ka masulug ne me nasud wey kene iya egpakaalihu ka Ihiptu. 43 Egkariralem te geem din ka karatuan ne me bulawan, pelata, wey me mahal ne kasangkapan te Ihiptu. Egkasakup din e degma ka Libya wey ka Itiyupiya. 44 Piru due me guhuren ne egpuun diye te igsile wey diye te igkahibang ne balabahan ne nakapabantal kandin. Purisu eggipanew sikandin ne egpangebel-ebel se langet eyew te pegdereet wey te peggule pegpangimatey te masulug. 45 Ne egpasasindeg sikandin te balungbalung din te pegkahari diye te elat-elat te dahat wey te bubungan ne napes-ekan te timplu. 40 “At the time of the end, the king of Syria will_be_attacked by the king of Ihiptu. But the king of Syria will_respond with all his power and he will_use chariots, horses, and ships. He'll invade nations like a flood and he'll destroy them. 41 He will_ also _invade the land of Israil and many people will_die. But Idum, Muwab, and the leaders of the Amunihanons will_be_able_to_flee. 42 He will_invade many nations and indeed Ihiptu won't be_able_to_avoid (it). 43 The wealth of gold, silver, and expensive furnishings of Ihiptu will_be_under his power. Libya and Ethiopia will_ also _be_under_ his _jurisdiction. 44 But there will_be_stories from the east and from the north (LIT left side) that will_make_ him _anxious. Therefore he will_travel with smoking anger in_order to destroy and to exterminate (by) killing many. 45 And he will_have_ his kingly tent _stood in the middle (between) the sea and the mountain where the temple is built. Despite that, death will_come to him and no (one) will_be_able_to_help him.”

Ka katammanan te timpu

The end of time

121 [xra][xrb]“Te seeye ne timpu, eglepew si Migil, ka maresen ne pangulu te me panalihan ne iyan ka talagtameng te keet-etawan te Israil. Ne egginguma ka timpu te samuk ne ware pad iya neyitabu bunsud te duen e nasud taman te sika ne timpu. Piru egkaluwas ka duma nu ne me keet-etawan ne nasulat se me ngaran diye te Libru te Manama. 2 [xr]Masulug te seeye se nammatey ne inlebeng e, ne egkengeuyag. Ka duma kandan egbehayan te umul ne ware egtamanan wey ka duma kandan egpakarawat te ware egtamanan ne pegkeyilew. 3 Ka seeye se me matagseb, egsiha iling kalayag te langit. Ka seeye se nakabagget te masulug ne etew ne egmatareng, egsiha iling te me bituen taman te ware egtamanan.

121 [xra][xrb]“At that time, Michael will_appear, the strong leader of the angels who is the watcher of the people of Israil. And the time of commotion will_arrive that has never happened from when there were nations until that time. But the others (LIT your(sg) companions) of (your) people that have (their) names written in the Book of God will_be_saved. 2 [xr]Many of those killed(pl) who were buried, will_come_alive(pl). Some of them will_be_given life without ending and others of them will_receive never ending shame. 3 Those wise(pl) (ones), will_shine like that brightness of sky/heaven. Those who encouraged many people to be_righteous, will_shine like stars without ending.

4 [xr]“Piru Danyil, kene nu pa ipangguhud ka lalag te seini ne baseen wey kene nu pa belata taman te katammanan ne timpu. Masulug ne etew ka eggendiye te minsan hendei eyew te pegsabut due.”

4 [xr]“But Danyil, don't(sg) story the word(s) of this document and don't(sg) yet unroll it until the end of time. Many people will_go wherever in_order for understanding this.”

5 Te pegpitew ku, duen e man-e nakita ku ne daruwa ne etew ne migsasindeg diye te tagse ilis te weyig. 6 Mig-inse ka sabeka kandan te seeye se migsaluub te hinabel ne migsasindeg diye te ampew te weyig ne migkahi, “Mamenu pad kaluhey ka katammanan te seini se me kein-inuwan?”

5 In my seeing, I also saw two people that stood there at the each edge of the water. 6 One of them asked that (one) dressed in woven_cloth that stood above the water and said, “How long (away) will the end of these wonders be?”

7 [xra][xrb]Ingkayew te etew ne migsaluub te hinabel ne migsasindeg diye te ampew te weyig ka me belad din wey narineg ku sikandin ne migpahunlibet te ngaran te Manama ne ware egpatayan. Migkahi sikandin, “Egkatuman sika peglihad te tatelu ne leg-un wey liware, ke egkataman en iya ka pegdereet te keet-etawan te Manama.”

7 [xra][xrb]The person dressed of cloth that stood above the water raised his hands/arms and I heard him swear by the name of God who has no death. He said, “That will_be_fulfilled after_the_passing of three years and a half, after_the_finishing indeed of the destroying of the people of God.”

8 Narineg ku ka tabak din piru ware ku nasabut, sikan naa ka mig-insa a kandin, “Ahalen, nekey naan e iya ka egtamanan te seini se langun?”

8 I heard his answered but I didn't understand, that's why I asked him, “Master, what is the ending of this all?”

9 Migtabak sikandin ne miggenendue, “Hipanew kad Danyil su ka tabak te inse nu kene pad igkapanengneng taman te katammanan ne timpu. 10 [xr]Ne egmatulusen wey eglinisan te Manama ka masalig ne etew, piru ka me maddeet egpabulus ne eggimu te mareet wey ware sabeka kandan ne egpakasabut. Piru seeye se me matagseb egpakasabut mule.

9 He answered going, “Go(sg) Danyil because the answer to your(sg) question won't be made_known until the end of time. 10 [xr]And many people will_be_made_holy and made_clean, but the evil(pl) (ones) will_continue to do evil and not one of them will_be_able_to_understand. But on_the_contrary those wise (ones) will_understand.

11 [xr]“Puun te timpu ne igpasanggel e ka aldew-aldew ne peghalad, ne iyan sika se pegtahu te makaalat-halat ne ‘talagdereet ne lilinditi’, eglihad pad ka 1,290 ne me aldew. 12 Keupianan te seeye se egtetahad wey egpekeuma te katammanan te 1,335 ne me aldew.

11 [xr]“From the time that the daily offering is caused_to_stop, which is the placing of the terrifying ‘dirty destroying (one)’, 1,290 days will_pass. 12 (There will_be) peace/prosperity to those who wait and arrive_at the end of 1,335 days.

13 “Piru sikeykew Danyil, pabulus ka ne matinumanen taman te katamanan. Egpatey ka piru eg-uyahen ke red te katammanan ne timpu eyew te pegdawat te dasag ne intahahe keykew.”

13 “But you(sg) Danyil, continue(sg) being obedient until the end. You(sg) will_die but you(sg) will_ just _be_made_alive at the end of time in_order for receiving the reward/gift that's been_prepared for_you(sg).”
